item.title: SPNI forays into South, elevates Rajaraman Sundaram as CCO
item.description: New Delhi: Sony Pictures Networks India (SPNI) is making its first entry into the southern markets, marking a major shift in its regional content strategy. To lead this expansion, SPNI has elevated Rajaraman Sundaram as Chief Content Officer, South. In this role, he will drive the network’s regional growth strategy, oversee content planning, and accelerate programming expansion across linear and digital platforms. item.title: Thums Up refreshes brand identity after more than 20 years
item.description: New Delhi: Thums Up has unveiled a new visual identity, marking its first significant design update in more than 20 years. The refresh reflects a broader repositioning of the brand as it responds to changing consumer sensibilities and evolving youth culture in India. item.title: Black Dog Soda appoints Emilia Clarke as global brand ambassador
item.description: New Delhi: Black Dog Soda has named actor Emilia Clarke as its global brand ambassador, marking a new phase for the brand’s ‘Savour the Pause’ philosophy, which focuses on mindfulness and being present in everyday moments. The partnership comes at a time when brands are increasingly tapping into broader conversations around slowing down and intentional living, as consumers navigate fast-paced, digitally driven lifestyles. item.title: Sonali Singh joins Switch Mobility as Head of Marketing
item.description: New Delhi: Sonali Singh has announced on LinkedIn that she has taken on the role of Head of Marketing at Switch Mobility. She highlighted her previous experience overseeing strategic marketing functions and brand management at Tata Motors, where she led regional campaigns, influencer marketing initiatives, and cross-functional planning processes to improve efficiency and customer engagement. item.title: Cloudflare acquires Human Native to enhance AI-ready structured content
item.description: New Delhi: Cloudflare has acquired Human Native, a UK-based AI data marketplace that connects creators with AI developers. The acquisition is intended to facilitate easier access to high-quality content for AI training and support content owners in deciding how their data is used, including options to block access, optimise for AI, or offer it for purchase. item.title: Sachin Tendulkar’s sports and athleisure brand Ten X You enters Myntra
item.description: New Delhi: Myntra has announced the e-commerce launch of Ten x You, a sports and athleisure brand co-created by former Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar. The debut marks the brand’s marketplace entry, with Myntra serving as its initial retail platform. item.title: Prasar Bharati 95th DD Free Dish e-auction, new MPEG-2 prices notified

item.title: JioStar posts Rs 8,010 crore gross revenue in Q3 FY26; JioHotstar averages 450 million MAUs
item.description: New Delhi: JioStar reported gross revenue of Rs 8,010 crore in Q3 FY26, according to the company’s latest quarterly performance update. Revenue from operations stood at Rs 6,896 crore during the quarter. The company reported EBITDA of Rs 1,303 crore in Q3 FY26, with EBITDA margin at 18.9 per cent. Profit after tax came in at Rs 888 crore for the quarter. For the nine months ended FY26, JioStar posted gross revenue of Rs 26,464 crore and revenue from operations of Rs 22,676 crore.
